real_defects.issue: When one payment's TipoCambioP is missing or not a number, MX-049 compared Totales' tax sums against the other payments only and blamed correct totals with two false findings (e.g. TotalTrasladosBaseIVA16 20112.07 'is not ... (10000.00)'). Now the tax sums are skipped with a note naming the payment.

An empty or non-numeric line tax Base (already MX-003) was summed as 0, so MX-034 blamed the correct summary Base ('Base 3550.50 is not the sum of the lines' bases (2700.00)'). Now a group with an unreadable line Base or Importe is not compared.

Class: across cfdi.mjs and pagos20.mjs an amount the schema rejects ("abc" or empty) was read as 0 (Number('') is 0) and the arithmetic rules then blamed correct values beside it: SubTotal (MX-030), header Descuento (MX-031), Total (MX-035), TotalImpuestos* (MX-033), the tax summary (MX-034, an unreadable TasaOCuota made a phantom rate group), ImporteDR bounds (MX-047), ImpuestosP (MX-048) and Pagos Totales (MX-049, an unreadable TasaOCuotaDR became an IVA 0% group). Each sum now skips with a note; unreadable-numbers.test.mjs tries every numeric attribute of both fixtures as 'abc' and '' and requires every finding to point at the broken attribute.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
